systems.system: Digital Transformation for Africa / Western Africa Regional Digital Integration Program (DTfA/WARDIP) SOP1
systems.owner: World Bank with The Gambia, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau and Mauritania
systems.tiers: regional programme with national components; appraisal document dated 2023-11-07; total US$293.00m, US$266.50m IDA

note: Programme appraisal document. It says the project will finance technical assistance to develop national whole-government digitalisation strategies in four countries including The Gambia, without naming or dating a Gambian strategy, so no fact is recorded.
